checkRuns.command:
sed -i "/import { browser }/d; s/if (!browser)/if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined')/" src/lib/favorites.svelte.ts
grep -rl '\$lib' src | xargs sed -i "s#\$lib/#\#lib/#g"
sed -i "s/let selected = \$state<string | null>(null);/let selected: string | null = \$state(null);/" src/routes/books/+page.svelte
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -30

sed -i "s#'\#lib/server/books'#'../lib/server/books'#" src/routes/+page.server.ts
sed -i "s#'\#lib/server/books'#'../../lib/server/books'#; s#'\#lib/favorites.svelte'#'../../lib/favorites.svelte'#" src/routes/books/+page.server.ts src/routes/books/+page.svelte
sed -i "s#'\#lib/server/books'#'../../../lib/server/books'#; s#'\#lib/favorites.svelte'#'../../../lib/favorites.svelte'#" "src/routes/books/[slug]/"*
sed -i "s#'\#lib/contact'#'../../lib/contact'#" src/routes/contact/*
sed -i "s#'../lib/server/books'#'../lib/server/books'#" src/routes/+page.server.ts
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -30

sed -i "s/form.errors : {}/form.errors ?? {} : {}/" src/routes/contact/+page.svelte bun run check 2>&1 | tail -5 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -5 PORT=4567 bun run start > /tmp/s.log 2>&1 & sleep 2 for p in / /books /books/dracula /books/nope /about /contact /xyz; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -o /tmp/o.html -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4567$p; grep -o "[^<]*" /tmp/o.html; done curl -s localhost:4567/ | grep -o "
    .*
" curl -s localhost:4567/books/frankenstein | grep -o "" | head -c 1500 echo; curl -s localhost:4567/books/xyz | grep -o 'aria-current="page"' curl -s -X POST -d "name=+Bob+&email=bad&message=short" localhost:4567/contact -H "origin: http://localhost:4567" | grep -o "" curl -s -X POST -d "name=+Bob+&email=a@b.co&message=long+enough+message+here+ok" localhost:4567/contact -H "origin: http://localhost:4567" | grep -o "Thanks[^<]*" kill %1

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/routes/contact/+page.svelte'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""	const success = $derived(
		sent ?? (form && 'success' in form && form.success ? form.name : null)
	);""","""	const success = $derived(
		clientErrors ? null : (sent ?? (form && 'success' in form && form.success ? form.name : null))
	);""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -2; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2; git status --short
